annotations.text:
Grüezi Schweiz — backpacker guide to Switzerland

Direction: Alpine Editorial. Bodoni Moda display + Karla body, warm paper #FAF8F5, Swiss red #C31B18 as a precision accent only.

All photography is drawn in CSS as placeholders — swap for licensed images before launch.

Working: carousel, map filters and pins, and the Groceries / Souvenirs tabs. Click them.

Tweak the Swiss red at the top of the artboard to restyle every accent at once.

Region page — Bernese Oberland

Working: the valley map filters by place type, and every pin swaps the detail card.

Beyond the brief: where to base yourself (four bases compared) and a three-day route from one bed, because the map alone does not tell you where to sleep.

Rail Passes

Working: pick any two stations and a number of moving days — the fare, the four buying options and the recommendation all recompute.

Fares are derived from approximate distances at a sample rate. Wire to live SBB pricing before launch.

Hostels

Working: people count, nights, sleeping preference and region all drive a real room allocation — dorm beds, twins and four-bed rooms — and the whole list re-prices and re-sorts for the group.

The greyed bed icons are capacity you pay for but do not fill (an odd number in twin rooms).

Find a Trip

Working: all four filter rows narrow the results live, with a real empty state when nothing fits all four. The search field is typeable but not wired to the results.

Daily budgets are sample estimates.
